QuestInfo.name: Fix That Seal!
QuestInfo.0: You tell Athena Pierce about the Black Mage, the broken seal, and your idea about using the Seal Stone to fix the broken seal.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce thinks your idea will work. She gives you the Seal Stone and says she'll meet you at the Temple of Time.
QuestInfo.2: You and Athena Pierce arrive at the Temple of Time, but she says the Gate of the Present is still closed... She gives some nonsensical explanation about why only you can enter the gate. Long story short, it's up to you to fix the Black Mage's seal.

1.0: But something doesn't make sense. You said the Gate of the Present is open, but it's not.\r\n#L0##bYes, it is! It totally is!#l\n#k
1.1: I think I understand. The temple distorts time and space to reject anyone not from Maple World. You're not originally from here, so the temple alters itself for you. But we can use that to our advantage. \r\n#L0##bEh, can you repeat that?#l\n#k
1.2: You don't have to understand the logic behind it. Just take this.

yes.0: You're Maple World's only hope now. Quickly, go and fix the seal!

npc.0: We have no time. You must get to the Temple of Time at once!
